ABOUT US

Who We Are

  • Equine Dispatch is a company that is dedicated to making the world of shipping horses just a little bit easier.

  • We are a team of horse lovers, riders, and owners who understand the challenges and needs of transporting horses across the country.

  • We are also a team of tech enthusiasts, innovators, and problem solvers who want to use our skills and knowledge to create a better solution for the horse industry.

What We Do

  • We build a platform that unites two parties: people who have horses to ship and the carriers who are looking to fill trailers.

  • We provide a simple, fast, and secure way for shippers to post their horse transport requests and for carriers to bid on them.

  • We also provide a smart and efficient way for carriers to optimize their routes, fill their empty spaces, and maximize their profits.

  • We facilitate the communication, payment, and feedback between shippers and carriers, ensuring a smooth and safe experience for both parties.

Why We Do It

  • We do it because we believe that shipping horses should not be a hassle, a risk, or a waste of time and money.

  • We do it because we want to help shippers find the best carriers for their horses, and carriers find the best opportunities for their business.

  • We do it because we want to create a more connected, transparent, and sustainable horse industry.

How We Do It

  • We do it by leveraging the power of technology, data, and network.

  • We do it by creating a user-friendly, mobile-friendly, and web-based platform that can be accessed anytime, anywhere.

  • We do it by applying the latest tools and techniques in web development, data analysis, and machine learning.

  • We do it by listening to our users, learning from their feedback, and improving our features and services.

Join Us

  • If you are a shipper who needs to transport your horse, sign up for free and post your request today.

  • If you are a carrier who wants to grow your business, sign up for free and start bidding on requests today.

  • If you are interested in learning more about us, visit our website : www.equinedispatch.com or contact us at info@equinedispatch.com

  • We look forward to hearing from you and serving you.
